description: Test prompts that verify rdk-accessories triggers and produces correct, source-grounded guidance for D-Robotics official accessories (GS130W/GS130Wi cameras, RDK IMU Module BMI088, S100/S600 expansion boards). Prompts are phrased the way a real RDK developer would (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: gs130wi-imu-is-icm42688
evals.prompt: GS130Wi 上内置的 IMU 是 BMI088 吗？我想直接用 BMI088 的驱动读它。
evals.expected_output: Corrects the chip: GS130Wi's built-in IMU is ICM-42688-P (over the right-eye MIPI shared I2C), NOT BMI088; BMI088 is the separate RDK IMU Module on 40PIN.

assertions.text: States GS130Wi's built-in IMU is ICM-42688-P, not BMI088.
Notes BMI088 is a different part (the standalone RDK IMU Module on the 40PIN header).
Warns the driver/IIO device name/registers differ, so the BMI088 driver does not apply.

evals.name: s600-camera-board-no-mipi
evals.prompt: RDK S600 的相机扩展板有几路 MIPI、几路 GMSL？
evals.expected_output: S600 camera board = pure 8x GMSL (2x MAX96712), NO MIPI; contrasts with S100 (2x MIPI + 4x GMSL).

assertions.text: States the S600 camera expansion board has 8x GMSL and NO MIPI interface.
Mentions it uses 2x MAX96712 (or contrasts with S100's MIPI+GMSL mix).
Does NOT claim the S600 camera board has MIPI camera connectors.

evals.name: gs130w-not-on-x3
evals.prompt: GS130W 双目相机能接在 RDK X3 上用吗？
evals.expected_output: No — GS130W needs dual MIPI; X3/X3 Module have single MIPI only. Supported: X5/X5M/S100(P)/S600.

assertions.text: Says GS130W is NOT supported on RDK X3 / X3 Module.
Explains the reason: X3 has only single MIPI, GS130W needs dual MIPI.
Lists supported boards (X5, X5 Module, S100/S100P, S600), noting S100/S100P need the Camera Expansion Board.

evals.name: imu-module-on-s100
evals.prompt: 我想把 RDK IMU 模组装到 S100 上读数，怎么弄？
evals.expected_output: S100 supports it but cannot mount directly (needs jumper wiring on 40PIN); read via official rdk-imu-module-sdk (not IIO, which is X5-only). Distinguish from the S100 MCU board's on-board BMI088.

assertions.text: Says the RDK IMU Module (BMI088) cannot mount directly on S100 and needs jumper wiring to the 40PIN.
Recommends the official rdk-imu-module-sdk (C/Python/ROS2), noting the IIO driver path is X5/X5 Module only.
Does NOT incorrectly tell the user to enable BMI088 via srpi-config IIO on the S100.

evals.name: ffc-orientation-and-power
evals.prompt: GS130W 的 FFC 排线怎么插？方向有讲究吗？
evals.expected_output: Power off first; GS130W module-side contacts face away from PCB; warn GS130Wi is opposite orientation.

assertions.text: Says to power the board OFF before connecting the FFC/FPC cable.
States GS130W and GS130Wi insert the FFC in OPPOSITE orientations (do not copy one onto the other).
Mentions the 22-pin / 0.5mm-pitch FFC and not yanking the flexible cable, or correct contact-facing direction.
